Overall this was a good experience, other than some of the side-effects.
Anyway, it was a normal day and my friend rang me and told me what I would think of taking some Codeine, and I said that I would agree.
The day came and I was looking forward to trying it. The time came and I took 3 pills (which is 90mg). For about 20mins I couldnt feel the effects, so I took another, then another. By the time it kicked in, I had taken 240mg. I felt really tired and sleepy. For about 3 hours it lasted, then after that it was still effecting me, but not as much.
Later on I took another 7 and felt the same effects.
I got some unpleasent side effects, like difficulty pissing, and ichyness all over my body.
Before I went to bed I took 2 just to set me off for the night.
I woke up this morning and felt rough as fuck. It was like being hung over. I still have the ichyness, which is very annoying, and I hope it doesnt last long.
Overall, it was a very good experience.
Also, keeping in mind how much Dihydrocodeine I took, Dihydrocodeine is x2 stronger than normal codeine
